tax_year.rationale: No canonical element for tax year exists in the W-2 MeF schema; it is carried as an attribute or envelope-level element, not a leaf in IRSW2.

employee_ssn.rationale: EmployeeSSN directly maps to Box a — employee's Social Security number.

employer_ein.rationale: EmployerEIN directly maps to Box b — employer's Identification Number.

employer_name.rationale: BusinessNameLine1Txt under EmployerName/BusinessNameLine1Txt captures the primary legal name of the employer (Box c).

employer_address.rationale: AddressLine1Txt under EmployerUSAddress matches the street address line from the employer address block (Box c).

employer_city.rationale: No CityNm element exists under EmployerUSAddress in the candidate list; the blueprint should add an employer_city field mapped to EmployerUSAddress/CityNm which is absent from this candidate set.

employer_state.rationale: No StateAbbreviationCd exists under EmployerUSAddress in the candidate list (only under W2StateTaxGrp); blueprint should map to EmployerUSAddress/StateAbbreviationCd which is absent.

employer_zip.rationale: No ZIPCd element exists under EmployerUSAddress in the candidate list; blueprint should map to EmployerUSAddress/ZIPCd which is absent.

control_number.rationale: ControlNum directly maps to Box d — employer-assigned control number.

employee_first_name.rationale: EmployeeNm is the only employee name element available; the schema stores the full name as one field rather than split first/last — blueprint bundles first name but canonical uses a single EmployeeNm, so this is the closest match.

employee_last_name.rationale: EmployeeNm is the only employee name element; the blueprint splits first/last name but the canonical schema uses a single EmployeeNm — both employee_first_name and employee_last_name map to the same element, indicating the blueprint should be refactored to a single employee_name field.

employee_suffix.rationale: No separate suffix element exists in the candidate list; the MeF schema embeds suffix within EmployeeNm, so there is no distinct leaf to map to.

employee_address.rationale: AddressLine1Txt under EmployeeUSAddress maps to the employee street address (Box f).

employee_city.rationale: No CityNm element appears under EmployeeUSAddress in the candidate list; blueprint should map to EmployeeUSAddress/CityNm which is absent.

employee_state.rationale: No StateAbbreviationCd appears under EmployeeUSAddress in the candidate list; blueprint should map to EmployeeUSAddress/StateAbbreviationCd which is absent.

employee_zip.rationale: No ZIPCd element appears under EmployeeUSAddress in the candidate list; blueprint should map to EmployeeUSAddress/ZIPCd which is absent.

wages_tips_other.rationale: WagesAmt directly maps to Box 1 — total taxable wages, tips, and other compensation.

federal_income_tax_withheld.rationale: WithholdingAmt directly maps to Box 2 — federal income tax withheld.

social_security_wages.rationale: SocialSecurityWagesAmt directly maps to Box 3 — wages subject to Social Security tax.

social_security_tax_withheld.rationale: SocialSecurityTaxAmt directly maps to Box 4 — Social Security tax withheld.

medicare_wages.rationale: MedicareWagesAndTipsAmt directly maps to Box 5 — wages and tips subject to Medicare tax.

medicare_tax_withheld.rationale: MedicareTaxWithheldAmt directly maps to Box 6 — Medicare tax withheld.

social_security_tips.rationale: SocialSecurityTipsAmt directly maps to Box 7 — tips subject to Social Security tax.

allocated_tips.rationale: AllocatedTipsAmt directly maps to Box 8 — tips allocated to the employee.

box_9.rationale: Box 9 (advance EIC, now reserved) has no corresponding canonical element in the MeF schema candidate list.

dependent_care_benefits.rationale: DependentCareBenefitsAmt directly maps to Box 10 — employer-provided dependent care benefits.

nonqualified_plans.rationale: NonqualifiedPlansAmt directly maps to Box 11 — nonqualified deferred compensation distributions.

box_12_entries.rationale: EmployersUseGrp (with child EmployersUseCd and EmployersUseAmt) represents Box 12 coded entries; the blueprint array aligns with this repeating group, but the group element rather than a scalar leaf is the best structural match.

statutory_employee.rationale: StatutoryEmployeeInd directly maps to Box 13 statutory employee checkbox.

retirement_plan.rationale: RetirementPlanInd directly maps to Box 13 retirement plan checkbox.

third_party_sick_pay.rationale: ThirdPartySickPayInd directly maps to Box 13 third-party sick pay checkbox.

box_14_entries.rationale: OtherDeductionsBenefitsGrp (with child Desc and Amt) represents Box 14 employer-use entries; the blueprint array maps to this repeating group element.

state.rationale: StateAbbreviationCd under W2StateLocalTaxGrp/W2StateTaxGrp maps to Box 15 first-jurisdiction state abbreviation.

employer_state_id.rationale: EmployerStateIdNum under the first W2StateTaxGrp maps to Box 15 first-jurisdiction employer state ID.

state_wages.rationale: StateWagesAmt under the first W2StateTaxGrp maps to Box 16 first-jurisdiction state wages.

state_income_tax_withheld.rationale: StateIncomeTaxAmt under the first W2StateTaxGrp maps to Box 17 first-jurisdiction state income tax withheld.

state_2.rationale: StateAbbreviationCd under W2StateTaxGrp is reused for the second jurisdiction via a second instance of the repeating W2StateTaxGrp group; same element idx, second occurrence.

employer_state_id_2.rationale: EmployerStateIdNum under W2StateTaxGrp is reused for the second jurisdiction via a second instance of the repeating group; same element idx, second occurrence.

state_wages_2.rationale: StateWagesAmt under W2StateTaxGrp is reused for the second jurisdiction via a second instance of the repeating group; same element idx, second occurrence.

state_income_tax_withheld_2.rationale: StateIncomeTaxAmt under W2StateTaxGrp is reused for the second jurisdiction via a second instance of the repeating group; same element idx, second occurrence.

local_wages.rationale: LocalWagesAndTipsAmt under W2LocalTaxGrp maps to Box 18 first-locality local wages.

local_income_tax_withheld.rationale: LocalIncomeTaxAmt under W2LocalTaxGrp maps to Box 19 first-locality local income tax withheld.

locality_name.rationale: LocalityNm under W2LocalTaxGrp maps to Box 20 first-locality name.

local_wages_2.rationale: LocalWagesAndTipsAmt is reused for the second locality via a second instance of the repeating W2LocalTaxGrp group; same element idx, second occurrence.

local_income_tax_withheld_2.rationale: LocalIncomeTaxAmt is reused for the second locality via a second instance of the repeating W2LocalTaxGrp group; same element idx, second occurrence.

locality_name_2.rationale: LocalityNm is reused for the second locality via a second instance of the repeating W2LocalTaxGrp group; same element idx, second occurrence.
